races.paceDynamic: Marvel Magic and Imperfectlyperfect will ensure honest early fractions in this novice hurdle, with both confirmed front-runners likely to engage from the start. The pace should be solid rather than breakneck over this 2m trip on testing ground, creating a rhythm that will build pressure from halfway. With most of the field hold-up types including Red Oak and Blues Singer, the leaders won't be pressured early but face a wall of challengers in the straight. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners and those with tactical pace who can position close enough to strike, as pure hold-up horses will struggle to make up ground on this going against an honest gallop.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front-runners collapse late
scenarios.trigger: If Marvel Magic and Imperfectlyperfect duel too hard early and both fade in the final furlong
scenarios.body: The honest pace becomes unsustainable and both leaders tire dramatically, allowing the best of the hold-up brigade to surge through. Red Oak and Blues Singer benefit most from this scenario with their class and finishing kick.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Pace holds strong
scenarios.trigger: If the front-runners maintain their gallop without collapsing and one finds extra
scenarios.body: The solid tempo favours horses that can track the pace without over-racing, making tactical speed crucial. Imperfectlyperfect's superior recent form gives him the edge over Marvel Magic in a sustained battle.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-up hero strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes truly searching and the field compresses turning for home
scenarios.body: The testing conditions and honest gallop bring the field together, allowing a classy closer to time their run perfectly. Red Oak's higher rating and Tom Bellamy's positional sense on Blues Singer become decisive factors.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider ambush
scenarios.trigger: If the favourites underperform and a mid-range horse finds improvement
scenarios.body: The novice nature of the contest allows for an improver to capitalize on market leaders disappointing. Hurlyburly's consistent form and Pimmsoclock's fresh legs from a long break could exploit any weaknesses.

races.paceDynamic: Choose A Copper, Rock On Jet, and Royal Deeside will ensure a strong gallop from the start, with Choose A Copper and Rock On Jet likely to dispute early leadership. The sustained pace over this 1m7½f trip will stretch the field and test stamina reserves, particularly on the softer ground which demands more from horses throughout. Rock On Jet's recent poor jumping (P in form) could eliminate one pace-setter, but the remaining leaders will still ensure a searching test. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can stay the trip and finish strongly, as the early pace will set up a finishing kick for those with tactical speed.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the front-runners maintain a strong gallop and set up the race for closers
scenarios.body: The sustained pace will drain the leaders and allow patient riders on Heads Or Harps, That One, and Powerofjet to time their challenges perfectly. The softer ground will emphasize stamina over speed, playing into the hands of horses held up for one decisive run.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Benefits All
scenarios.trigger: If Choose A Copper and Rock On Jet go too fast early and tie up
scenarios.body: The race will become tactical in the final stages, allowing prominent racers like Flash Du Pistolet to capitalize on their forward position. Any horse with a turn of foot will benefit from the slow-finishing pace.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front-Runner Gets Away
scenarios.trigger: If Rock On Jet jumps cleanly and gets first run on his rivals
scenarios.body: His early lead could prove decisive if he settles better than expected and his jumping holds up. The strong pace behind will help his cause as chasers tire in pursuit.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Midfield Tactical Move
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is moderate and allows a mid-division horse to steal a march
scenarios.body: A horse like Too Cool Forshrule could make a well-timed move from midfield when others are still waiting. The tactical nature would suit horses with racing versatility over pure stamina.

races.paceDynamic: Gintime will lead from the start with no other confirmed front-runners to challenge her early, creating a sustainable tempo that won't test her stamina reserves over this 2-mile trip. She's Notjoeking will likely track in second or third, providing the main early pressure if any develops, but with six hold-up horses behind them the pace should remain controlled throughout. The lack of early speed will create a tactical affair that builds gradually, with the real racing beginning from the second-last hurdle. This race shape strongly favours the prominent and hold-up runners who can finish fastest, as Gintime may struggle to resist late challenges after doing the donkey work.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Strong Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Gintime sets too strong an early gallop or She's Notjoeking applies unexpected pressure from the second circuit
scenarios.body: The leaders will weaken dramatically in the final quarter-mile, allowing the fresher hold-up horses to sweep past with superior finishing kicks. The patient tactics of the back-markers will prove decisive as stamina becomes the determining factor.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Tactical Crawl Finish
scenarios.trigger: If Gintime is allowed to dictate at her own leisurely tempo with minimal early pressure from She's Notjoeking
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint from the last hurdle with all horses still in contention, favouring those with the most natural speed and tactical nous. Class and turn of foot will separate the field rather than stamina.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Gintime finds the perfect rhythm and the hold-up horses fail to coordinate their challenges effectively
scenarios.body: Her sustainable early lead translates into an unassailable advantage as she quickens approaching the final hurdle, with the chasers leaving their runs too late. The front-running tactics prove optimal for the conditions.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If both Gintime and She's Notjoeking go too fast early trying to establish position on the soft ground
scenarios.body: The entire field comes back to the long-priced hold-up horses who benefit from the strongest pace scenario of all. The outsiders get the perfect setup for their preferred running style.

watchPoints.text: Gintime may struggle to quicken if allowed to dictate terms completely, as her recent form suggests she's vulnerable to late challenges

The soft ground conditions favour those with proven form on similar surfaces, particularly Dee's Getaway and My My My Delilah
Any early pace pressure between Gintime and She's Notjoeking will dramatically change the complexion and favour the hold-up horses
Watch for late headway from the hold-up horses turning for home, as they should have plenty of horse left to run

races.paceDynamic: I See The Sea and Lewa House will contest the early lead, with King Of Cong and Blue Indigo likely to sit prominent. This creates a moderate early gallop that should suit the hold-up horses in the field. The large field of 16 runners means the pace will be competitive but not suicidal, allowing the backmarkers time to organize their challenge. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can pick their way through traffic and finish strongly up the hill.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If I See The Sea and Lewa House set a steady pace without killing each other off
scenarios.body: The moderate early gallop allows the talented hold-up brigade to get into contention turning for home. Jamesieconn, Dr Shirocco and Streamsforth Lad benefit from the patient tactics on this stamina-testing track.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Strike
scenarios.trigger: If King Of Cong or Blue Indigo can get first run on the leaders
scenarios.body: The race becomes tactical enough for horses sitting handy to exploit their position advantage. King Of Cong's recent form and Blue Indigo's lightweight give them the edge over the held-up runners who face traffic problems.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Benefits Closers
scenarios.trigger: If I See The Sea goes too slow and allows the field to compress
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace means the race becomes a sprint finish where class tells. Jamesieconn and Dr Shirocco benefit most from their superior ratings when the race becomes a test of pure ability rather than stamina.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Front Runners Steal It
scenarios.trigger: If I See The Sea gets an uncontested lead and kicks clear
scenarios.body: The early leader gets such an easy time that the backmarkers cannot reel him in up Hexham's stiff finish. Lewa House and King Of Cong also benefit from being close enough to capitalize if the leader weakens.

races.paceDynamic: Party In The Park is the only confirmed front runner and will dictate terms from the start, likely getting an uncontested lead on the soft ground. With Stylish Recruit the only prominent runner, there's minimal early pressure, allowing Party In The Park to control fractions through the early stages. The field is dominated by hold-up horses (Rock Dj, Asa, Eire Street, Getaway Master, Balking, Divilabother, Do Ye Wanna, Woodview Lad) who will track behind waiting for their moment. This scenario creates a tactical race where the lone leader may get away with soft fractions early before the field closes late, clearly favouring front-running tactics and those who can track the pace closely.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Front Runner
scenarios.trigger: If Party In The Park gets away with moderate fractions and maintains stamina reserves
scenarios.body: The lack of early pressure allows the leader to dictate ideal splits and kick clear approaching the final flight. Hold-up horses struggle to make up the ground as the pace wasn't strong enough to set up their finishing kick.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Charge Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the soft ground saps Party In The Park's stamina reserves in the final half-mile
scenarios.body: The lone leader weakens approaching two out, opening the door for the strongest stayers with hold-up tactics. Class horses with proven soft ground form benefit from the collapse of the pace angle.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If Party In The Park stops dramatically and Stylish Recruit also fades early
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish between multiple hold-up horses converging simultaneously in the final furlong. Light-weighted horses and those with tactical speed gain crucial advantages in the resulting cavalry charge.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Strong Gallop Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Stylish Recruit forces Party In The Park into a genuine pace battle from early
scenarios.body: Both pace-setters engage in a stamina-sapping duel that sets up the race perfectly for closers. The strongest stayers with proven class benefit from the strong early gallop.
